## Top sellers
Circana has revealed the best-selling games of 2024 overall in the US. Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 ranked No. 1 for 2024.
Black Ops 6 was also the No. 1 best-selling game in the US for December 2024. In fact, the Call of Duty franchise has now been the No. 1 best-selling franchise in the US in terms of dollar sales for a record 16 years in a row.
CFB 25, meanwhile, was No. 2 for 2024 overall, and ranked No. 1 on Xbox platforms. It is now the best-selling sports video game in US history.
The reporting period for the charts below covers December 30, 2023 through January 4, 2025. Read on to see the top 20 best-selling games of 2024 so far.
Bear in mind, the list includes dollar sales, as well as physical and digital data from many publishers, but not all (Nintendo does not share digital data, for example). These rankings also do not include add-on content and microtransaction revenue.
With 2024 over and done with, you can now also see [2025’s best-selling games](https://www.gamespot.com/gallery/2025-best-selling-games/2900-6281/) so far.
